name: @penguinharness/skill-porting
description: Port from external ecosystems after reviewing every file: skills into this agent's agent_state/skills/ (Claude Code plugin marketplaces, the Codex plugin repo, skills.sh registry names, GitHub repos, local folders), or a whole plugin (a Codex or Claude Code plugin, a skills repository, a folder in a GitHub repository) into a PenguinHarness plugin package installed on the server with penguin plugin install, or a whole agent from another coding tool (Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek Harness, Qoder, Qwen Code, WorkBuddy) into a new Agent with penguin agent import.
